description: Creates, renames or deletes workbook folders: `make` a folder; `rename_from` to `rename_to`; or `remove` (delete) one with the folders under it.

make.description: A folder path to create, e.g. Clients/Sagamore.

remove.description: A folder to delete, with the folders under it.

rename_from.description: The folder as it is now.

name: edit_folders
title: Create, rename or delete folders
